analogfix.configuration.title: AnalogFix
analogfix.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Download each track in full before it plays, and play it from disk. When off, Analog Audio streams as normal.
analogfix.configuration.maxCacheSizeMB.t: Least recently played tracks are deleted when the cache grows past this size.
analogfix.configuration.audioFormat.tool: MP3: keep only the audio, converted to mp3 (video is dropped). ORIGINAL: keep the downloaded file as-is.
gui.analogfix.clear_cache.confirm.title: Clear Analog Audio cache?
gui.analogfix.clear_cache.confirm.messag: This stops all Analog Audio playback and deletes %s cached tracks (%s). They will be downloaded again the next time they play.
gui.analogfix.clear_cache.done.title: Audio cache cleared
gui.analogfix.clear_cache.done.locked: %s %s files are still in use and will be deleted on next launch.
